details: Manifest provides standalone mode, project-relative id/start/scope and 192/512 icons
Every icon is a real PNG of the declared dimensions
HTML links manifest, theme, touch icon and PWA client
Precache succeeds for the complete app shell, scripts, icons and all five data files
All 16 cached URLs return offline without making any network request
Offline data reads tolerate cache-busting query strings
Direct dataset navigation stays JSON rather than being replaced by the HTML shell
External links, other Pages projects and non-GET requests are not intercepted
Activation removes only old cache versions for this exact app scope
An explicit update request can activate a waiting worker
A missing core dataset rejects installation rather than activating a partial offline atlas
Cache names are isolated across project scopes on the same GitHub Pages origin
The same worker also supports root-domain hosting
method: Manifest/icon checks and service-worker lifecycle/offline fetch tests using real bundled asset bytes
phoneInstallation: Manifest and offline behaviour verified; physical phone installation is user-performed.
